decision_rule.train: mean(candidate) - mean(baseline train) must be greater than the larger per-arm population stdev. The frozen baseline train margin to beat is 0.0833. If this arm's own train pstdev is larger, that larger margin applies.
decision_rule.lockbox: keep needs lockbox mean delta > 0. A lockbox noise of 0 is not a win while both means stay at 0.6 (delta 0 reverts as flat).
decision_rule.not_a_promotion_claim: A same-contract repeat is not an attributable change (prompt/skill/rubric/model/effort). Do not pass these scores to factory learn --promotion. Do not change production reviewer policy or the gate.
